title: GRIPS: An Empirical Study of Pre-SQL Grounding Information for SQL Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.02314v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems answer natural language questions over structured data, but can fail before SQL generation by linking question mentions to the wrong table, column, value, or relation. Even valid SQL can then return an incorrect answer. This raises a central question: What pre-SQL information helps a SQL generator, and when does additional information cease to help? We investigate this question on TempTabQA-C and BIRD. Among the audited SQL Static failures, grounding errors form the largest category on both benchmarks. We introduce GRIPS (Grounding Representation and Input Processing for SQL generation), a three-stage method that derives structured pre-SQL information to make these decisions explicit before query generation. Across GPT-5-nano and Llama-70B, GRIPS-Adaptive improves over SQL Static in 18 of 20 settings, with an average accuracy gain of 11.8 percentage points, while reducing model-call token usage by 47.8%. translated_title: GRIPS：SQL生成中SQL前置接地信息的实证研究
translated_abstract: 文本到SQL（Text-to-SQL）系统针对结构化数据回答自然语言问题，但在SQL生成之前就可能失败，例如将问题中的提及链接到错误的表、列、值或关系，此时即使生成的SQL语法有效，也可能返回错误的答案。这引出了一个核心问题：什么样的SQL前置信息对SQL生成器有帮助，而额外信息何时不再有帮助？我们在TempTabQA-C和BIRD两个基准上研究了这一问题。在审计的SQL Static失败案例中，接地（grounding）错误在两个基准上都是最大的类别。我们提出了GRIPS（SQL生成的接地表示与输入处理），这是一种三阶段方法，通过导出结构化的SQL前置信息，使这些决策在查询生成之前变得明确。在GPT-5-nano和Llama-70B的实验中，GRIPS-Adaptive在20个设置中的18个上超越了SQL Static，平均准确率提升11.8个百分点，同时将模型调用的token使用量降低了47.8%。
tldr: 该论文提出GRIPS三阶段方法，通过在SQL生成前显式提取结构化的接地信息，在两个基准上20个设置中的18个实现平均11.8个百分点的准确率提升，同时将token使用量降低47.8%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces GRIPS, a three-stage method that explicitly derives structured pre-SQL grounding information before query generation, improving accuracy by an average of 11.8 percentage points across 18 of 20 settings while reducing model-call token usage by 47.8%.
